name: akaar-instantmesh-proxy
description: Public-facing proxy for the GPU workstation's model APIs (InstantMesh reconstruction + Fooocus-API co-creation). Fixes InstantMesh's CORS bug, requires a valid Supabase login, rate-limits job submissions, content-moderates every submission (via ../moderation-service, local/no-cost), and serializes the two models on the shared GPU.
